packageRules.description: flake inputs: one pull request a week
image digests that move under the same tag: one pull request a week
database majors need a dump and restore, done by hand
comfyui's python base moves with comfyui and its torch wheels, by hand
immich server (heimdall) and machine learning (mimir) move together
scrutiny web and collector (both odyn apps) move together

wowsims: my own image, built by ci in jivsan/wowsims-image from wowsims' source. here it's the engine on mimir (hosts/mimir/modules/system/wowsims.nix), in talos-helheim the page (kubernetes/apps/wowsims), and both have to be the same build: renovate opens a pull request there too for each new tag, and both titles say so. its tag is the build's time and wowsims' commit, like 2026.11.13-184628-be13cfb: read as date and time, or renovate would never see a newer one. it never merges by itself
prBodyNotes: the engine here and the page in talos-helheim have to be the same build. this one first, the same day: merge it, on mjolnir `git pull && git push origin main` (the hosts pull from github), `deploy mimir` once ci is green, then merge the pull request with the same tag in jivsan/talos-helheim (flux rolls the pod a minute later). not this one alone. a sim that runs while one of them changes is lost, i start it again.

after both, they must name the same wowsims commit (it prints `same build: <the new tag>`):
```sh
p=$(curl -s https://sims.oryxserver.org/forever/version.json | grep -o '[0-9a-f]\{40\}' | cut -c1-7)
e=$(curl -s https://sims.oryxserver.org/version | grep -o '"version": *"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
[ -n "$p" ] && [ "${e##*-}" = "$p" ] && echo "same build: $e" || echo "not the same: page $p, engine $e"
```
the engine's memory: after the first big batch with a new build, `sudo podman stats --no-stream wowsims-engine` on mimir. near 2.5 GB, --memory and GOMEMLIMIT in wowsims.nix go up together.

packageRules.description: scrutiny's influxdb stays on 2.8: 2.9 turns on token hashing, which can't be undone
immich's postgres (odyn/apps/immichdb) on its own, never in one pull request with server and ml, and it stays on 16: a new postgres or vectorchord needs its own plan
moving heimdall's data to odyn (2026-10): no updates for these while they move, so a new image never lands between the rehearsal and the move. each comes off this list a week after its app moved
